# Class: `VideoFrameSource`

Decodes a single video, exposes frame metadata, and manages video preview caching.

[Module](API-Module-icescopy-frame-source.md) | [Source](../src/icescopy_frame_source.py#L247) | [API index](API-Reference.md)

**Bases:** `FrameSource`.

The grayscale modes are converted grayscale and the video luma plane (brightness data directly from a supported decoded format). They are different measurement choices. Call `close()` to release decoder resources and an owned temporary cache; do not rely on finalization for deterministic cleanup. Metadata may be inferred from regular spacing before a full decode fallback; check timing-sensitive changes against variable-frame-rate files.
